headline: Anil B. Virani Triggers SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) in Jyoti CNC Automation
sum: Anil B. Virani has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling a material stake acquisition or announcement-stage bid in Jyoti CNC Automation Limited, a precision engineering firm.
detail: Anil B. Virani submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer crosses 25% of voting capital or announces a formal takeover bid. The filing with NSE on 23 June 2026 confirms the transaction has reached announced stage. Further details on consideration, structure (scheme vs. open offer), conditions and timeline are not disclosed in the primary Bar & Bench brief; corroboration of fuller terms requires access to the full NSE filing or company stock exchange announcements.
